items.name: theme
items.title: nb theme
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: The house theme: slate ground, hairline borders as rgba tints, 10px uppercase micro-labels, tabular figures, pill state, 8px card radius, and the single warm cream note reserved for search-match highlight. Lifted verbatim from stratechery-search. A `registry:theme` item, so it installs as cssVars plus a css string that the CLI merges into the consumer's own stylesheet: there is no target file, the consumer keeps its @import "tailwindcss", and no import line is added.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: Sticky top bar with backdrop blur, wordmark, back pill on non-root views, 68rem main, and footer strip. The house application frame.

items.name: stat-strip
items.title: Stat Strip

items.title: Burst Timeline
